test_title: PYST 26: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight boys A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). B is fourth to the left of H. Only two boys sit between F and B. E is second to the left of D. F is second to the left of C. C is an immediate neighbour of G. C is not an immediate neighbour of B. Who is sitting on the immediate left of E?
solution: **Given:** Eight boys A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre. 1) B is fourth to the left of H. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bcc98d88c1ce804974c075099ad4d52ed6e1cef04d349ed66d88503f7a3fe1ba.png] 2) Only two boys sit between F and B. 3) F is second to the left of C. 4) C is not an immediate neighbour of B.
